verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a mobile authenticator app, so the axis applies. The pack documents no telemetry or usage-tracking controls. The 'Use without an account' option only skips account-based code syncing, which is an adjacent feature and not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
